files.projects/shop/.locmetryrc:
version = 1

[[rules]]
id = "src"
match = ["src/**"]
purpose = "production"

[[rules]]
id = "tools"
match = ["tools/**"]
purpose = "production"
category = "tooling"

[[refinements]]
id = "helpers"
purpose = "test"
match = ["tests/helpers/**"]
category = "test-support"

prompt:
You have ./bin/locmetry and synthetic inputs in this scratch directory. Work only here. The executable and its built-in discovery material are your only product documentation; do not read other directories, implementation files, telemetry, or the launcher, and do not use the internet or other agents. You may inspect synthetic inputs and use ordinary shell/Python tools. You may create files only below outputs/; leave projects/shop unchanged. For projects/shop, save two tables exactly as Locmetry prints them for people, not JSON: the table of the project's source code by category to outputs/categories.txt, and the folder table restricted to test code to outputs/test-folders.txt. Report the test code lines of each test category.

Use whatever built-in discovery you need. Give a concise final answer of at most 250 words, including supporting commands and any unresolved result. Create the requested working artifacts, but do not write an assessment document or a logging harness.
grading: Recovered mistakes may pass; record recovery cost. A missing table file, a file holding JSON instead of the printed table, or wrong test code by category => incomplete or critical failure. Inspect fixture integrity and supporting calls.
